* Begins composing an email to the address from the given mailto: URL.
 *
 * @param {string} linkURL - mailto: link to use.
 * @param {nsIMsgIdentity} [identity] - The identity to use, otherwise the
 *   default identity is used.
 * @param {nsIMsgCompFormat} [format] - If given, the preferred compose format
 *   to use. 'mailto' URLs containing 'html-body' or 'html-part' fields are
 *   always opened in HTML mode.
 */
function composeEmailTo(
  linkURL,
  identity,
  format = Ci.nsIMsgCompFormat.Default
) {
  MailServices.compose.OpenComposeWindowWithURI(
    null,
    Services.io.newURI(linkURL),
    identity,
    format
  );

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: composeEmailTo delegates to OpenComposeWindowWithURI with the identity. GetParamsForMailto passes that identity to DetermineComposeHTML before constructing the parameters. Setting identity only after parsing would leave the format decision based on another identity. Current source also accepts a preferred format, while URL HTML fields override the default-format path and HTML sanitization can fall back to plain text. Preserve this ordering and those exceptions. The browser test covers different identities, opposite default formats, Shift clicks and an html-body URL; no live composition was run. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Pass the mailto identity before choosing the compose format
